component_guidelines.cards: Use flat dark backgrounds (bg-slate-900/90 or bg-gray-900) with subtle 1px border (border-slate-800). Add subtle hover border color shift (hover:border-slate-700).

buttons.primary: bg-cyan-500 hover:bg-cyan-400 text-slate-950 font-semibold px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors shadow-md shadow-cyan-500/20
buttons.destructive: bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white font-semibold px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors shadow-md shadow-rose-600/20
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 transition-colors
buttons.outline: border border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-lg

component_guidelines.inputs: bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 focus:border-cyan-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-500 text-slate-100 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm placeholder:text-slate-500
component_guidelines.dialogs_and_dropdowns: MUST have solid bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-slate-100 shadow-xl (NEVER transparent background).
component_guidelines.toasts: Use sonner for notifications with custom dark maritime styling.

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: Every interactive button, input, tab, card metric, filter dropdown, and modal MUST contain a kebab-case `data-testid` attribute.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Use Javascript (.js / .jsx) for components as the codebase is JavaScript.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modals, or headers - always use rich solid dark bg-slate-900 or bg-slate-950.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for automated test compliance.
Maintain strict mobile-first layout with bottom navigation tabs on small screens and sidebar on lg screens.
Emergency Pause state must globally reflect across all active tabs with visual banner indicators.
